page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The CPU provides a 33 MB L3 cache, alongside support for instruction sets including AVX-512F and AES hardware acceleration. The instance is paired with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per virtual core. It includes no bundled local storage and requires remote network storage for persistence. Network connectivity provides a baseline throughput of 6 Gbps, and no GPUs are provisioned.

Benchmark results highlight solid multi-threaded capability balanced by modest single-threaded throughput. The instance achieves a PassMark CPU score of 23,056.78 and a stress-ng multi-core metric of 23,516.07, positioning its parallel processing in the middle tier. In contrast, single-core metrics fall into lower brackets, evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 967.0 and single-threaded gzip compression at 19.12 GB/sec. Large-block memory bandwidth reaches 87.55 GB/sec for read operations and 43.49 GB/sec for writes, supporting tasks such as Redis key-value operations at 23.19 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile delivers substantial CPU and memory density without the premium attached to local NVMe storage or hardware accelerators. However, the older Intel architecture yields lower instructions per clock compared to newer core designs, making the instance less cost-effective for single-threaded or compute-heavy serial tasks. The configuration is best aligned with distributed multi-threaded applications, enterprise backend services, static web serving pools, memory-backed caches, and moderate database operations that utilize balanced compute and RAM allocations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose compute instance equipped with 32 dedicated vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. Configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, it maintains a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio suitable for broad enterprise workloads. The virtual machine has no integrated local disk storage, relies on external network volumes, provides a 6 Gbps baseline network throughput, and contains zero GPUs. Performance benchmarks show middle-tier multi-threaded execution, illustrated by a multi-core Geekbench score of 8,400.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 23,056.78, though single-core execution remains in the lower performance quartiles. With 23.19 million Redis SET operations per second and 13.88 GB/sec in static web throughput, it functions effectively for clustered backend environments, caching layers, and general multi-threaded enterprise services.
